messages.subject: Project Ember — Report on Title
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel, Caroline,

Please find our report on title attached. In short: good and marketable title, nothing that should stop you proceeding. Key actions before completion: (1) the seller will discharge the Clydesford Bank charge; (2) you'll need to be VAT-registered and opt to tax to preserve TOGC — we're handling the mechanics; (3) we recommend taking the restrictive-covenant indemnity insurance (~£3,950); and (4) we've agreed a £100k service-charge retention.

SDLT is £1,227,000. Happy to take you and the board through this before the 27th.

Best,
Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0521
